title: cross-functional-roadmap-sync-notes
content:
Cross-functional roadmap alignment sync (Product + Eng + Applied ML) - prep notes and follow-ups

Date: 2026-03-01
Owner / note-taker: Jordan Kim
Attendees (expected): Maya Singh (Product), Diego Ramirez (Engineering - Serving Runtime), Priya Kapoor (Applied ML), Liam O'Connor (SRE), Jordan Kim (PM/host)
Location: Zoom + recording in channel #roadmap-sync
Meeting length: 60m
Objective: Surface cross-team dependencies for Q2 roadmap items, align on trade-offs (latency vs cost vs accuracy) and finalize owners + next steps for model serving experiments and rollout windows.

Prep (what I will bring / ask attendees to prepare):
- Product: short list of top 3 prioritized features for Q2 with acceptance criteria and target KPIs (eng cost, latency SLO, user-facing metric).
- Eng (Serving Runtime): capacity plan for dedicated pools, rough latency/cost estimate for each feature under current infra and quantized variants.
- Applied ML: short eval summary of model variants (vanilla fp16, 8-bit quant, LoRA fine-tune) and expected quality delta on representative prompts.
- SRE: any region/capacity constraints or maintenance windows in Q2.
- Everyone: highlight blockers and required tickets to unblock delivery.

Proposed agenda (60m):
1) 5m - Quick context + goals (Jordan)
2) 15m - Product priorities overview (Maya) - features + KPIs
3) 15m - Eng throughput/cost implications (Diego) - capacity asks and gaps
4) 15m - Applied ML tradeoffs (Priya) - eval summary + recommended model variant per feature
5) 5m - Decision & owners (round-robin)
6) 5m - Parking lot + immediate action items

Key discussion points to surface (prep prompts):
- For feature A (in-product summarization): expected 95th pct latency target 300ms; is that realistic on current Dedicated 8xA100 profile when using 8-bit quant vs fp16?
- For feature B (real-time reranking + tool calls): batching vs latency trade-offs; can we run smaller micro-batches on dedicated pool without violating cost targets?
- ML eval: quality regression threshold for quantized model is max -2% on Rouge/ROUGE-L for feature A; is that acceptable to Product?
- Rollout plan: can we stage model variant per region (EU first) to reduce blast radius? What telemetry do we need?

Notes / live capture (from pre-reads + quick sync before meeting):
- Product: Feature A and B are top priority; Feature C deprioritized if engineering needs extra runway. Feature A target launch window: mid-May (2026-05-15 planned).
- Eng: Current dedicated pools show headroom for burst but sustained throughput for Feature B will require reserving >=2 nodes in pool or autoscale policy tuned. Latency estimates: fp16 ~220ms median, 95th ~420ms; 8-bit quant projected median 180ms, 95th ~350ms (estimates rough).
- Applied ML: small eval set (n=300 prompts) shows 8-bit quant for model v2 has mean metric drop ~1.6% (within threshold). LoRA for feature-specific prompts yields +0.7% on key metric; cost trade-off small but adds complexity to serving.

Decisions (proposed to confirm in meeting):
- Approve 8-bit quant variant for Feature A for initial rollout with canary in EU region. Engineering to implement fallback to fp16 for high-error cases.
- For Feature B, prioritize latency SLO; will run micro-batching with strict per-request timeout and activate Dedicated reserved capacity for peak windows.
- Instrumentation: need per-route latency/cost dashboards + prompt-sampled quality checks (1k samples/day) to catch regressions.

Action items (owner / due date / notes):
- Diego: Create capacity request ticket and autoscale policy draft for Dedicated pool for Feature B (RI-2345). Due: 2026-03-08.
- Priya: Finalize expanded eval (n=1k) for the 8-bit quant variant and include edge-case prompt suite. Post results to Confluence page. Due: 2026-03-10. Linked: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=78901234
- Maya: Confirm product acceptance criteria for quant trade-off (explicit max allowable metric delta and rollback criteria). Add to feature PRD. Due: 2026-03-05.
- Jordan: Create rollout canary plan doc (region sequence, traffic % ramp, rollback thresholds) and assign monitoring owner. Due: 2026-03-09.
- Liam: Set up per-route dashboards (latency P50/P95, cost per token, error rates) and alert for 10% regression. Provide dashboard link before rollout. Due: 2026-03-12.
- Diego + Priya: PoC for fallback path (auto-switch to fp16 if sampled-quality drops below threshold). Create GH PR and link in ticket. Due: 2026-03-18. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/482

Open questions / risks:
- Risk: Quantized models may have unpredictable failure modes on rare prompts not covered in eval set. Mitigation: broader prompt sampling + canary in low-traffic region.
- Dependency: Dedicated capacity reservation needs finance approval for Q2 commit if we exceed burst credits. Who on finance to loop in? (Action: Maya to loop in Samir Patel from finance after acceptance criteria confirmed).
- Telemetry: Need to define exact sampling rate for qualitative checks; trade-off between cost and signal.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Explore running hybrid inference (CPU fallback for simple prompts) to reduce cost for non-critical requests (later spike).
- Evaluate potential of LoRA-only lightweight models for Feature C if prioritized.

Next meeting / cadence:
- Proposal: weekly 30m sync until feature A canary launched (target: 4 meetings), then biweekly. Jordan to schedule recurring invite (starting 2026-03-08).

Notes to self (things to remember when running the meeting):
- Keep discussion focused on concrete trade-offs and owners; avoid deep dives into model training during this sync. Pull Priya into follow-up ML deep dive if needed.
- Use the decision table quick template (approve / approve w/conditions / defer) to close each feature decision in meeting.
- Capture exact rollback thresholds (metric deltas, error rate increases) in the canary plan doc.

Quick checklist for post-meeting follow-up email:
- Publish notes + decisions to Confluence (Jordan)
- Create/update tickets referenced above and link PRs + Dashboards
- Tag each action with owner + due date and send reminder to collaborators

End of notes.
